observations.text: The state just before the anger
observations.meaning: The state just before the anger. Haman went out "joyful and glad of heart. But when Haman saw Mordecai … he was filled with wrath" (Est 5:9). Uzziah "grew proud, to his destruction" (2Ch 26:16; lēḇ in the text) before his anger at the priests (26:19). "the haughtiness of his heart" before Moab's insolence (Jer 48:29).
